claim: NullPropagatedOperands recurses into every SqlBinaryExpression unconditionally on OperatorType, but AndAlso/OrElse (and Coalesce) do not propagate NULL under SQL three-valued logic, so the IS NOT NULL guard is wrongly dropped and the CASE collapses. Queries whose THEN result is a boolean expression silently return true/false where the C# expression evaluates to null; on SQL Server bare comparisons in result position are also non-propagating because SearchConditionConvertingExpressionVisitor maps UNKNOWN to false.
raw: #1 🔴 Critical: `NullPropagatedOperands` treats *every* `SqlBinaryExpression` as NULL-propagating, so `AND`/`OR` results lose their null guard and return `true`/`false` where the query must return `null`
